name: bdf_get_eurozone_indicator
description:
A euro area indicator: ez_cpi (HICP inflation, annual rate of change in percent, monthly; HICP.M.U2.N.000000.4D0.ANR), ez_gdp (GDP at current prices, EUR millions, quarterly, euro area 21; MNA) or m3 (M3 money supply, annual growth rate in percent, monthly; BSI.M.U2.Y.V.M30.X.I.U2.2300.Z01.A).
Returns: series_code (ECB flow.key), series_id, label, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): indicator (ez_cpi, ez_gdp, m3; default ez_cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For France use bdf_get_french_indicator; ecb_get_series covers more euro area series.
Example: {"indicator": "m3", "start_date": "2025-01", "end_date": "2026-06"}
